subject: SVE and SVE2 optimizations (#159)
perf_evidence: The commit subject explicitly identifies SVE and SVE2 optimizations.
change_summary: Reworks SVE/SVE2 vector division paths for signed and unsigned widths.
notes: Both old and new SVE/SVE2 paths compile to LLVM IR, but this Alive2 build cannot parse scalable vector values. No semantic relation is claimed.

units.name: SVE vector division, API and raw forms
units.evidence: Alive2 rejects scalable vector types, e.g. Unsupported type: <vscale x 8 x i16>.

units.name: SVE2 vector division, API and raw forms
units.evidence: Alive2 rejects the SVE2 scalable vector types in both directions.
